requirement: Two conversations on one EmDash site take turns writing, and Stop sends nothing while waiting

oracle.ref: PR #1479 (fix); fix evidence: Review 19/10/2026: EmDash writes went straight to the site's MCP with no write lease
oracle.invariant: S1: B waits, A writes on, B writes after A's turn ends. S2: nothing sent, even when the lease frees then. S3: every road acquires first; none writes meanwhile.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: 🔒 Q1: two conversations on one EmDash site — B waits for A, A writes on meanwhile, B writes once A’s turn ends

🔒 Q1: every EmDash write road takes the lease first — tracy_emdash, media.upload, content.replace — and none writes while another holds it
